transform.axisConvention: X east, Y north, Z up

processing.method: Preview-derived approximate ground cap from regular XY bins over the existing Utah FORGE Phase 3 MT resistivity model preview.
processing.topologyInference: Cells use p95 scene-Z values, sparse/deep exterior bins are rejected, only the largest connected upper component is retained, one local edge dilation is allowed, and triangles connect only adjacent grid cells.
notes: This is a standalone approximate ground cap generated only from the existing 90,000-point Utah FORGE Phase 3 MT resistivity model preview.
Only the existing MT resistivity point preview JSON is read by this surface generator.
It is not connected to the MT scalar trim/feather legend or any resistivity subset decomposition.
It intentionally avoids raw sparse-column top triangulation because that creates vertical icicle sheets.
This is not measured ground terrain or interpreted geology.
No seismic, wells, faults, terrain, infrastructure, or other future data family is processed.

reviewStatus.notes: Approximate ground cap from the existing 90,000-point MT resistivity preview only. Not surveyed terrain, not an interpreted geological contact, and not a seismic product.
